name: ea-ww-probe
title: ea-ww-probe
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test-only waterway probe: dumps the tiles of the chunks the runner lists (corridors, fords, isthmuses, spawns), checks waterway placements with can_place_entity in the M3 modset (with Cargo Ships) and runs scripted path requests. The runner writes ww-spec.lua into a staged copy at run time. Never shipped.
